articles.title: Institutional Context
articles.excerpt: Institutional Context It can be difficult to understand how policymaking in the European Union works. This page aims to improve public understanding of the EU AI Act’s institutional context. This summary was put together by Hadrien Pouget , an AI policy expert at the UK AI Security Institute. articles.title: Assessment
articles.excerpt: Assessment University of Oxford researchers have created a tool called capAI , a procedure for conducting conformity assessment of AI systems in line with the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. CapAI provides organisations with practical guidance on how to translate high-level ethics principles into verifiable criteria that help shape the design, development, deployment and use of ethical AI. This tool can be used to demonstrate that the development and operation of an AI system are trustworthy. Th...
